# Helix Research Technologies

> AI agents for lab, medical, and B2B supply companies. Quote Desk Agent, Reorder Follow-up Agent, AI Receptionist, GoHighLevel systems, custom apps. Fixed price quoted in writing after one call. Client owns the code, accounts, and data. Based in Fredericksburg, VA, serving the US.

## What we build
- [Quote Desk Agent](https://helixresearchtech.com/services/quote-desk-agent): answers quote requests in minutes with real prices from the client's catalog.
- [Reorder Follow-up Agent](https://helixresearchtech.com/services/reorder-follow-up-agent): follows up on open quotes and predictable reorders.
- [AI Receptionist](https://helixresearchtech.com/services/ai-receptionist): voice and chat agent that answers, books, and logs.
- [GoHighLevel Systems](https://helixresearchtech.com/services/ghl-systems): CRM, pipelines, automations, reporting.
- [Custom Apps and Sites](https://helixresearchtech.com/services/custom-apps): portals, dashboards, integrations, marketing sites.

## Who it is for
- [Lab and research supply](https://helixresearchtech.com/industries/lab-supply)
- [Medical supply](https://helixresearchtech.com/industries/medical-supply)
- [B2B distributors](https://helixresearchtech.com/industries/distributors)

## Pricing
- [How pricing works](https://helixresearchtech.com/pricing): free 30 minute call, priced workflow audit credited against the build, fixed-price builds, optional monthly agent plans. No hourly, no seat fees.
